status: retrospective research; existing windows and categories have already been inspected
selection: report every candidate; no claim of independent holdout or contest victory
event_scale: past observations before candidate onset only
event_deduplication: first confirmed onset; next two onsets suppressed
forecast_improvement: same forecast pairs; report absolute and relative MAE and all origins
early_warning: detection and prediction evaluated separately; alarm budgets fixed at 1%, 2%, 5% of municipalities
